'''November 2000 Boulder tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Boulder, CO on 12 November 2000. [[Brian Hunter]] won it. It is known from Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1458">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-13-boulder-co-11-12-00-2-cold-4-speedersd1458/ boulder-co-11-12-00-2-cold-4-speeders], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 13 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-13-boulder-co-11-12-00-2-cold-4-speedersd1458/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 12 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Boulder, CO
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
